senses.gloss: m. (גָּרַע) I) deduction from the price of redemption according to the years of possession (Lev. XXVII, 18).
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 24a:32">Arakh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ליגאל בג׳</he> to be redeemed with due deduction.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 106a">B. Mets. 106ᵃ</cite> the Sabbath year <he>לא תעלה לו בג׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מן הג׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. s. l. note 90) ought not to be counted in for deduction.—Pl. <cite ref="C01308"><he>גֵּירוּעִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:1:2">Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36ᵈ</cite> <he>סוף גֵּירוּעֶיהָ</he> the final redemption of the Hebrew hand-maid.
